info.name: Reqres API Testing Portfolio
info.description: API testing portfolio collection for the Reqres Demo API. This collection is organized to demonstrate smoke testing, positive scenarios, negative scenarios, boundary testing, contract testing, regression testing and basic response time observation. Requests should use the Reqres API Environment and reusable variables such as {{baseUrl}}, {{validUserId}}, {{validEmail}} and {{validPassword}}.

item.description:
Contains the minimum critical API checks used to confirm that the main Reqres endpoints are available and responding as expected before running the full test suite.

This folder includes core smoke scenarios for user listing, single user retrieval, user creation and valid login.

These tests validate basic API availability, expected HTTP status codes, JSON responses, key response fields and absence of internal implementation details.

item.name: 02 - Users - List and Pagination
item.description:
Contains user listing requests used to validate pagination, custom page size, JSON response structure and list-user contracts.

This folder covers positive and functional scenarios for retrieving user lists from different pages and with custom pagination parameters.

These requests validate HTTP status codes, JSON Content-Type, pagination fields, integer value constraints, data array structure and absence of internal implementation details.

item.name: GET - List users from page 1
item.description:
Related IDs:
- Endpoint ID: EP-001
- Test Case ID: TC-001

Purpose:
Validates that the API returns a successful users list response when requesting the first page.

Expected:
- Status code 200
- Response body is valid JSON
- Content-Type includes application/json
- Response contains pagination fields
- Pagination numeric fields use number JSON type with integer values
- Response page matches the requested page
- Response contains a data array
- User objects contain id, email, first_name, last_name and avatar when data is not empty
- Response does not expose internal implementation details

item.name: 05 - Authentication

item.name: 06 - Resources
item.description: Contains Reqres resource/color endpoints used to validate resource list, single resource and not found behavior.

item.name: 07 - Boundary Tests
item.description: Contains edge case requests using zero values, negative values, non-numeric values, empty bodies, empty fields, special characters and long strings.

item.name: 08 - Contract Tests
item.description: Contains response structure validations used to confirm expected JSON types, value constraints, success contracts and error contracts.

item.name: 09 - Delayed Response
item.description: Contains delayed response scenarios used for basic response time observation. These tests should not be included in the smoke suite.

item.name: 10 - Regression Tests
item.description: Contains selected high-value scenarios used to confirm existing API behavior after changes in scripts, environment, collection structure, Newman setup or CI workflow.
